_what_this_is: One record of the published, frozen vintage. Committed so the page renders the download from a fact rather than from memory, and so a reader can check the page against the archive. Nothing here is typed by hand twice: every value below was read from vintage/2026-11-16/MANIFEST.json and confirmed against the live copies.

verified_note: Anonymous checks on 2026-11-19: the Hugging Face copy of pharmacy_listings.csv downloaded with no credentials and its SHA-256 matched the manifest byte for byte; the DOI resolved to the Zenodo record; the Zenodo zip downloaded anonymously and was byte-identical to the uploaded one.
